units.source_text: 但是，在从小闻惯的熟悉气氛中，叔叔又突然将婚姻问题摆在了我的面前。

en.t: But amid the familiar atmosphere whose scent I had known since childhood, my uncle suddenly set the question of marriage before me again.

units.source_text: 他不过是把去年的劝说重复了一遍，理由也和去年完全一样，

en.t: He was merely repeating the persuasion of the previous year, and his reasons were exactly the same as they had been then,

units.source_text: 只是上回谈的时候没有说出具体对象，

en.t: except that when he spoke of it last time, he had not named any specific person,

units.source_text: 这次却明确地提出了候选人，因此我就更加为难了。

en.t: whereas this time he clearly put forward a candidate, and that made me all the more troubled.

units.source_text: 那位姑娘就是叔叔的女儿，也就是我的堂妹。

en.t: That young woman was my uncle's daughter, in other words, my cousin.

units.source_text: 叔叔说：‘你娶她对彼此都有好处，

en.t: My uncle said, “If you marry her, it will be good for both of you,

units.source_text: 你父亲生前也这么说过，我也觉得这样做比较有利。’

en.t: your father said the same while he was alive, and I also think it would be more advantageous this way.”

units.source_text: 父亲对叔叔这样说过也不是不可能，

en.t: It was not impossible that my father had said such a thing to my uncle,

units.source_text: 但我是听叔叔这样说了之后才知道的，

en.t: but I only learned of it after hearing my uncle say so,

units.source_text: 只是并不记得曾经有过这码事，因此颇感意外。

en.t: and since I did not remember anything of the kind ever happening, I was quite surprised.

units.source_text: 虽说意外，但也知道叔叔的要求并没有什么不妥。

en.t: Although it surprised me, I also understood that there was nothing improper about my uncle's request.

units.source_text: 也许我是个粗心大意的人吧，

en.t: Perhaps I was simply a careless person,

units.source_text: 不过主要原因恐怕还是从来没有对堂妹留心过。

en.t: but the main reason was probably that I had never paid any attention to my cousin.

units.source_text: 我从孩提时起，就常常去住在市里的叔叔家玩耍，

en.t: From the time I was a child, I often went to my uncle's house in town to play,

units.source_text: 还常常留宿在叔叔家。

en.t: and I often stayed overnight there as well.

units.source_text: 所以，从那时候起，跟这位堂妹就很熟悉了。

en.t: So from that time on, I was very familiar with this cousin of mine.

units.source_text: 你也知道的，兄妹之间产生恋情，还没有先例。

en.t: As you know, there has been no precedent for romantic love arising between a brother and sister.

units.source_text: 也许我是借用这一公认的事实来敷衍吧。

en.t: Perhaps I was merely using this accepted fact as an excuse.

units.source_text: 我总觉得朝夕相处的男女之间，

en.t: I have always felt that between men and women who live together day and night,

units.source_text: 会失去相爱所需的刺激引发的清新感觉。

en.t: the fresh feeling stirred by the stimulus necessary for falling in love is lost.

units.source_text: 正如在焚香的一瞬间才闻得到香味一样，

en.t: Just as incense can be smelled only in the instant when it is first burned,

units.source_text: 品酒只有在刚入口的一刹那才最有味道。

en.t: wine tastes best only in the instant when it first enters the mouth.

units.source_text: 以此类推，爱情的冲动也只存在于顷刻之间，

en.t: By the same reasoning, the impulse of love also exists only for a fleeting moment,

units.source_text: 一旦没有感觉地度过那个瞬间，

en.t: and once one has passed through that moment without feeling anything,

units.source_text: 那么越熟悉就只会越亲密，

en.t: then the more familiar one becomes, the closer one merely grows,

units.source_text: 只会使爱情的神经渐渐麻痹下来。

en.t: and it only causes the nerves of love to grow gradually numb.

units.source_text: 我思来想去，无论如何也不想娶这位堂妹做妻子。

en.t: No matter how I thought it over, I simply did not want to take this cousin as my wife.
